title: Cylinder Re=100: first-stage scientific visualization

source.source_policy: read-only; audited time and mesh copied to a separate local derived case view

physics.gravity_note: not defined or applicable in this single-phase cylinder case

software.paraview: 5.12.1 for extraction and Q; 5.13.3 bundled Python for server paper layout
software.renderer: Intel Iris Xe Graphics, OpenGL 4.5, offscreen=true
software.osmesa: not used; the offscreen OpenGL smoke test passed
software.python_analysis: isolated project .venv for statistics; ParaView bundled Python for lightweight server layout

render.paper_plane_reduction: every second coordinate from the audited 641x361 probe; values retained without smoothing
render.gradient: computed from full 3D cell U before interpolation and slicing

statistics.merge: old segment t<290; recovery segment t>=290; conflicting duplicates fail
statistics.uncertainty_warning: insufficient independent samples for a defensible confidence interval
statistics.spectrum: not produced in this first-stage bundle

warnings: The fixed nondimensional vorticity scale saturates values outside [-2, 2]; the paper-plane extrema are approximately [-13.45, 14.03].
The retained Q image predates schema v2 and colours Q* surfaces by dimensional vorticity; new renders colour them by omega*=omega L_ref/U_ref.
Visible angular transitions near the cylinder follow mesh-resolution transitions and persist across independent sampling checks; the paper layout uses an exact stride reduction and no smoothing.
Startup Cd impulses at t=0.01 and 0.02 s are retained in the overview and excluded only by the declared statistics window.
The portable pvsm stores cylinder.foam as a relative placeholder and requires relinking to the derived case view when opened.

acceptance.visual_review: passed after opening the final PNGs at full and reduced size
